primary_claim: An automated 'probe-prompting' pipeline that measures feature activation responses to concept-varying prompts and groups features into concept-aligned supernodes achieves 0.53 Replacement / 0.83 Completeness on Neuronpedia metrics for 'capitals' attribution-graph circuits in Gemma-2-2B, outperforming geometric (cosine-only, layer-adjacency) clustering baselines on behavioral-coherence interpretability metrics, with entity-swap tests showing early-layer features generalize much more (~80-92% overlap) than late-layer features (~0-50%).

effect.metric: Replacement / Completeness scores (Neuronpedia) for concept-aligned subgraphs vs. geometric clustering baselines
effect.value: concept-aligned subgraphs average 0.5394 Replacement and 0.8257 Completeness across 5 prompts, outperforming cosine-only and layer-adjacency clustering on behavioral metrics like Peak Token Consistency (0.425 vs. 0.183/0.301) and Activation Pattern Similarity (0.762 vs. 0.130/0.415)

contradicts_or_qualifies: Extends Anthropic's attribution-graph / Cross-Layer Transcoder circuit tracing methodology, which per Neuronpedia's own estimate requires ~2 hours of manual analysis per prompt, by automating supernode construction
stated_future_work: Run a templated sweep over all US state-capital graphs (then all countries) to demonstrate automation at scale, reporting per-graph and aggregate Neuronpedia metrics
Run three causal interventions (feature ablations, steering, cross-circuit transfers) and report logit deltas alongside Neuronpedia metrics before and after intervention
limitations_stated: Current evidence is limited to Gemma-2-2B CLT-HP with short factual prompts; no claim of immediate generalization to long chain-of-thought, adversarial settings, or larger models without adaptation
Validation relies on Neuronpedia's graph metrics and cross-prompt stability; causal interventions (steering/ablation) are planned but not yet implemented
A cross-lingual failure occurred applying the English pipeline to a French prompt, producing incoherent activations and no valid supernode grouping
Entity-swap transfer results used only structurally identical prompts; robustness to paraphrases, reorderings, and cross-domain transfers is untested
Reported differences between concept-aligned grouping and baselines are descriptive; statistical significance tests were not performed
quote: our concept-aligned subgraphs attain ~0.53 Replacement and ~0.83 Completeness on Neuronpedia metrics, averaged across runs, and outperform geometric clustering on behavior-based interpretability metrics.
